title: Release 0.5.0: bump, tag, push plugin and marketplace
description: plugin.json and the marketplace entry say 0.4.0; main is 25+ commits ahead of origin (Markdown scenarios, scenario skill, profiles, beds, sfx, calibrate, phone voices, audit fixes). The bundled senior-vadik profile carries crude content, including the intro's slur rhyme: Denis knows it goes public.
acceptance_criteria: Version 0.5.0 in plugin.json and marketplace.json; tag v0.5.0 pushed; claude plugin update installs it; the installed skills list shows three skills with the new descriptions.

title: Pick the narrator and fix the stress in «Вадик»
description: Denis heard an Indian tinge in the narrator and the stress on the wrong syllable in «Вадик». narrator_test.wav compares the current narrator with three designed candidates (B Moscow baritone, C Petersburg radio host, D Soviet documentary) and three spellings: Вадик, Ва́дик, ВАдик. Waiting on Denis's pick.
acceptance_criteria: Chosen narrator copied into profiles/senior-vadik/voices/narrator.*, levels recalibrated; the spelling that stresses ВА́дик is written into characters.md and used in every episode.

title: Normalize every rendered episode to -16 LUFS, true peak -1 dBTP
description: Apple's podcast spec: -16 LUFS integrated, true peak at or below -1 dBTP (podcasters.apple.com/support/audio-requirements). Today scene.py only scales the mix down when it would clip, so episodes land at whatever level they happen to reach. Add a final loudness step after beds and sfx are mixed (pyloudnorm, already used by calibrate.py), with a --loudness flag (default -16, 0 to skip). Approved by Denis 2026-10-28.
acceptance_criteria: A rendered episode measures -16 +-0.5 LUFS integrated and true peak <= -1 dBTP; timeline.json timings unchanged; one [perform] log line with the measured before/after; --loudness 0 renders as before.

title: Calibrate stas, kristina and indian2
description: levels.json has no entry for stas (speaks in episode 3), kristina or indian2. Episode 3 clips include stas; kristina and indian2 need a short line each.
acceptance_criteria: levels.json has entries for all ten voices in voices/; measured from clips with clips.json so gains are not double-counted.

title: Test the falling-transition fix by ear
description: Rising transitions work with stepped tags; falling ones (joy to tears) paused at the tag and sounded like another person. The scenario skill now prescribes one breath, a bridge word, one arc tag that ends deflated. Not yet heard.
acceptance_criteria: A test render of 3 falling lines in the new style; Denis says they sound like one person; the skill rule loses its 'not yet tested' note or is replaced.

title: Let a sound effect start under the line that cues it
description: sfx are placed like turns, after the previous turn ends. Practice: start an effect 100-200 ms before the cue word, or under the line, without covering words. Add an anchor to the next turn, e.g. {sfx phone_ring @next-0.2}, or document the negative-gap pattern if it already covers this.
acceptance_criteria: A scenario can start an effect 0.2 s before the next turn begins; lint or docs show the pattern; no effect covers a word in the episode 2 remix.

title: Fade the bed in and out at episode edges
description: Assumed practice: episode fade-in 1-2 s, fade-out 2-3 s. Check ambience.py: the bed fades in before the first word (XFADE) but may stop dead at the end.
acceptance_criteria: The last bed fades out over 2-3 s after the final line; the first bed fades in over 1.5 s; heard on episode 3.

title: A/B the ambience bed level: 24 dB vs 18 dB under speech
description: Beds sit 24 dB under speech plus 9 dB ducking. A vendor source puts ambience 12-18 dB under dialogue, so ours may be too quiet to set the scene. Remix episode 2 from its clips at 24, 18 and 15 dB and let Denis pick by ear.
acceptance_criteria: Three remixes sent; Denis's pick becomes ambience.py's default and is written into the perform skill.

title: Check whether э-э and ммм fillers come out spelled
description: The scenario skill says to prefer word fillers because sound fillers may be read as letters; tone_test.wav has the line, not yet judged.
acceptance_criteria: Denis judges the tone_test filler lines; the skill keeps or drops the rule accordingly.

title: Gate ruff and pyrefly with prek pre-commit
description: pyproject.toml carries ruff and pyrefly config from the shelf blueprint, but nothing runs them. The blueprint uses prek; bd hooks were skipped at init on purpose (bd never installs hooks; see shelf docs/runbooks/adopt-beads.md).
acceptance_criteria: A .pre-commit-config.yaml runs ruff check, ruff format --check and pyrefly on commit; prek install done; a bad commit is refused.

title: Remove the merged sound-design worktree and branch
description: claude/upbeat-jang-cb2a7a is merged into main (ecf6882). Its worktree under .claude/worktrees/ belongs to the sound session; remove it only once that session is done or archived.
acceptance_criteria: git worktree list shows no stale worktree; the branch is deleted locally.

title: Check the phone filter against a 300-3400 Hz band-pass
description: Telephone band is 300-3400 Hz (sourced). scene.py phone_line() was written by the sound session; confirm its corners match and that Мама's calls stay intelligible.
acceptance_criteria: phone_line corners documented in its docstring and within 300-3400 Hz; a phone line in episode 2 sounds like a phone.
